'''Coral Depths City''' was a suburb of [[Foamwander City]] on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. Most of the [[City/Legends|city's]] population, which contained a number of [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] and financial traders, worked in Foamwander.<ref name="Strongholds" />
